title: docs(pm-skill): the fifth readings increment — 26 measured platform facts
body:
Fixes #15977
Fixes #16006

Refs #16104 (section 1 only — its sections 2 and 3 stay open on that card for their own split)
Refs #15803 (section C only — that card's section A is in the decision box and its labels are untouched here)
Refs #16386

The fifth increment into `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`, one flight over four carriers. Every candidate fact was deduplicated against the ledger **as PR #15955's head leaves it** (`04b61b5f6a`, 362 lines) rather than against `origin/main` (359 lines), because that PR's three fourth-increment lines are not on `main` yet. Facts stated by two carriers land as one line with both carriers named. Nothing was deleted and nothing was re-wrapped.

## Ruling executed

The ceiling decision on #16386 was ruled **A** — director seat, decision batch #62, 2026-09-07, maintainer verbatim and untranslated: 「同意」 — in https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/16386#issuecomment-5563909225. Its words: the ledger's line ceiling "rises to the measured count", **385** on that day's `main`, "or **388** if PR #15955's ruled raise (362) lands first — the same +26 either way". PR #15955 landed first, so this round executes the 388 leg.

**This patch round does exactly two things, and nothing else.**

1. `origin/main` merged in as a **merge commit** (never a rebase, never a force-push), which brings PR #15955's ruled ceiling of 362 and its own `ruledRaises` record. The ledger file itself is untouched by this round; it is now **388 lines** on the branch — 362 plus the same 26 measured lines the candidate table below accounts for.
2. `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `+15 −1`: the `CEILINGS` row for `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` moves **362 → 388** (before → after), and **one** `ruledRaises` record is appended. No other line in that script, no other ceiling, and nothing in the ledger file.

The appended record, as it stands in the map:

```js
{
  ruling:
    'the fifth-increment raise on'
    + ' `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` — maintainer,'
    + ' decision batch #62, 2026-09-07, verbatim and untranslated: 「同意」 on option'
    + ' A, and the sentences that ruling adopts, in the director record\'s own words'
    + ' (comment 5563909225): "`references/platform-readings.md`\'s line ceiling rises'
    + ' to the measured count: 385 on today\'s `main` (359 → 385), or 388 if PR'
    + ' #15955\'s ruled raise (362) lands first — the same +26 either way."',
  date: '2026-09-07',
  delta: 26,
}
```

The declared cross-file move is untouched by the raise: the destination now reads **+11** (314 → 388, less 63 lines of ordinary ruled raise — 34 + 3 + 26) against the sources' unchanged net decrease of 20, which is exactly the +11 the move landed with.

### Reverse verification — the raise is paid by the RECORD, not by the number

Every exit captured before any pipe.

| leg | exit | reading |
|---|---|---|
| live run, pre-patch head `65a6c814d4` (after the merge) | **1** | `✗ … platform-readings.md is 388 lines; the ratchet ceiling is 362.` — 1 of 1 failing assertions |
| live run, patched head `34f19d1b89` | **0** | `✓ … platform-readings.md is 388 lines (ceiling 388; headroom 0).` — 0 failing assertions |
| `--self-test`, patched head | **0** | `✓ check-skill-line-ratchet self-test: 155 cases pass.`, the last of them `✓ every live ruled-raise record quotes its ruling, dates it, and names a positive line count` |
| the new record **deleted** in a scratch copy, ceiling left at 388 | **1** | `✗ … raises its ceiling 314→388, less 37 lines of ordinary ruled raise (+37) against a net source decrease of 20` and `✗ … the declared cross-file moves raise the map's total by 17 lines.` |

The scratch copy is a mirror outside the repository — the script plus `scripts/invoked-as.mjs`, with `.claude/`, `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` symlinked to this worktree — and its **unmutated control run is byte-identical** to the in-tree run above, which is what makes the mutated leg readable. The mutation was confirmed on disk by occurrence counts before the run (`5563909225` 2 → 0, `delta: 26,` 1 → 0, the `388` ceiling row still 1), and the copy was restored afterwards with `git hash-object` equal to the worktree's file. The working tree was never mutated: `git status --porcelain` stayed clean across both legs.

### Gates on the final commit `34f19d1b89`

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived **38** families from the change set (2 paths, three-dot against `origin/main` merge base `245c6a23c`); all 38 were run and reconciled:

```
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
```

- 37 of the 38 exited **0** on the first run. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` exited **3** — PREREQUISITE NOT MET, `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt — and exited **0** after building both, so it is a real reading rather than a NOT-MEASURED.
- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` (self-test + live) — **0**.
- `node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --self-test` — **0**, 190 cases.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on this PR's **full** file list — **3**, GOVERNED as expected: `.claude/** ×1` on the ledger file, with `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` reported as not on the register. A human merge is the review record.
- `pnpm check:nul-bytes` — **0**, and `grep -naP` for the C0 range plus DEL over the edited file returns nothing.
- Whole-repo `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) through `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (slot `issue-15977-p2`, acquired on the first try with the full budget, no poll-and-retry): `VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 94s · waited 0s`.
- Eight further families whose roster sits under a directory one of these paths is in — where the derivation says the silence is evidence in neither direction — were run as well: `check-published-list-mirrors`, `check:console-injection`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:pm-label-desc-cap`, `check:pm-governed-prose` and `check:skills-token-ratchet`, all **0**. `pnpm check:published-readme-exports` exited **3** (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 43 packages whose built type entry it reads are unbuilt) and is recorded as NOT MEASURED, not as a finding — it wants a whole-repo build, which CI performs.

PR #16437 (the self-test roster on this same script) is still **queued**, not landed, so the conflict proof was run against its head twice on the final commit:

| leg | command | exit | CONFLICT lines | resulting tree |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| driver as configured | `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD 2c9c1a5282` | **0** | **0** | `c94c4f99ce8ef78dba9f4272c0d8d58a3ac810f0` |
| driver forced off | `git -c merge.os-regen.driver=false merge-tree --write-tree HEAD 2c9c1a5282` | **0** | **0** | `c94c4f99ce8ef78dba9f4272c0d8d58a3ac810f0` |

⚠️ **The section “The ratchet is RED on purpose” below records this branch BEFORE this round**, and it — like every other pre-existing section, the candidate table and the open question the director ruled option A on — is deliberately left byte-identical. The ratchet is green now, at headroom 0.

This patch round was executed by session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox` (attribution recorded in prose because a body edit normalises the footer's session URL away). Nothing else on this PR was moved: the draft state, the approving review, the armed auto-merge and the labels are all as the approver left them.

## What changed

**26 lines added, 0 removed, 0 re-wrapped.** 359 to 385 lines on this branch. Widest line 120 bytes (`LC_ALL=C awk`), unchanged — the per-line budget is respected by every new line.

## The ratchet is RED on purpose

```
✗ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md is 385 lines; the ratchet ceiling is 359. Keep the surface compressed: principles in SKILL.md, on-demand detail in .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/ — provenance is one line, stories live on cards, not in operational text. Raising a ceiling requires a maintainer ruling quoted in the PR.
```

That is the **only** red in the whole ratchet run — 1 of 1 failing assertions across every ceilinged file (`grep -c` on the run's own output). The ceiling map is deliberately **not** touched by this diff: the ceiling is the maintainer's, and the number this PR asks him to rule is **385** (or **388** if PR #15955 lands first and carries its own three lines in, which is the same +26 either way).

## Merge-tree proof against PR #15955's head, run twice

`.gitattributes` routes generator-owned paths to the `merge=os-regen` driver, and this clone has that driver registered, so a single clean run would only prove "the driver took it". Both legs were run:

| leg | command | exit | CONFLICT lines | resulting tree |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| driver as configured | `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD 04b61b5f6a` | **0** | **0** | `73062b4612a878e2039958634f0defdca56b35c9` |
| driver forced off | `git -c merge.os-regen.driver=false merge-tree --write-tree HEAD 04b61b5f6a` | **0** | **0** | `73062b4612a878e2039958634f0defdca56b35c9` |

Identical trees, both exits 0, zero `CONFLICT` lines. The new lines sit at the **end of each section**; PR #15955's three lines sit mid-section (its offsets 147, 254, 293), so the two diffs never touch the same hunk.

**48 candidates evaluated: 25 rows landed (26 lines — row 48 landed two), 11 already PRESENT, 12 DECLINED.**

### The one candidate that needed its own measurement

Row 48 sits next to lines 26–28, which read that `merge-tree` answers the default text merge and does **not** apply the `.gitattributes` driver. Rather than assert a contradiction, the mechanism was measured in a throwaway repo on this container (git 2.43.0): one path routed to a custom driver, both sides changed, driver `true`.

- driver registered: `git merge-tree --write-tree` exit **0**, no `CONFLICT` line
- `-c merge.NAME.driver=false`: exit **1**, `CONFLICT (content)` on that path

So both readings are true and the missing variable is **registration**, which this repo makes per-clone (`pnpm install` runs `prepare`). The two landed lines say exactly that and prescribe the two-leg proof; lines 26–28 are left standing and untouched, because reconciling them is a decision, not a mechanical fold-in. See the open question below.

## 验收备注

- **The ceiling was deliberately left alone.** The ratchet map's row for this file still reads 359 and its headroom is 0. Moving it is the maintainer's, and this PR does not pre-empt it.
- **No line was deleted and none re-wrapped.** The ratchet's own currency rule (content deleted, never a re-wrap) is respected by having paid nothing at all: this increment asks for the raise instead.
- **Two carriers stating one fact land once.** Rows 5, 6, 7, 9, 13 and 29 are each one line carrying two carriers; row 26 folds two rounds of one card.
- **Twelve declines, every one with its reason on the row.** Nine are repo-local engineering facts, most of them already routed to objectui's own references by the grading comment on #16006; two are author-side or dispatch-authoring disciplines that the ledger's own line 267 and the dispatch brief already hold; one is a sizing tactic already covered by lines 83–84.
- **`skip-changeset` applies**: this PR publishes nothing from any package — it edits one markdown file under `.claude/`.
- **Not flipped ready, not enqueued, not approved, no auto-merge armed.** `.claude/**` is a governed surface; the human merge is the review record.
- Commit messages carry no card relation; the card relations are declared here, once, because the branch squashes.

**CI reading on this head (57cd6389d6), every run complete:** 29 check runs — 1 failure, 15 success, 13 skipped. The single failure is `Lint & Repo Gates`, and its failing STEP is number 28, `PM skill line ratchet` — every step before it green, ESLint included. ⚠️ The job stops at that step, so its 100-plus later gate steps report `skipped`, **not** green: that is precisely why the 16 derived families were run locally and reconciled with `--ran` rather than read off the PR.

**noted, not filed** (under the #16351 admission threshold): the `Lint & Repo Gates` job aborting at its first failing step means a PR carrying one red gate never displays the rest of the farm's verdicts — the same measurement defect as `turbo run` without `--continue` recorded on #15803's 14:17Z comment, one layer up in a shell job. Not filed as a card: it is an observation about CI ergonomics, not a reproducible product defect, a declared-contract violation, or a metadata-authoring trap. The seat files it at ACCEPT if it judges otherwise.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**这是什么。** 平台读数账本的第五次增量,把四张卡上已经量到的平台事实,一条一行写进 `references/platform-readings.md`。四张卡是:#15977(通过 MCP 建卡会丢掉正文末尾的署名页脚块,并吃掉标题里的尖括号片段;改走 REST 建卡就正常)、#16006(spec@objectui 席位 09-05 整班量到的平台事实)、#16104 的第 1 节、#15803 的 C 节。后两张只取其中一节,另外几节留在各自卡上按它们自己的节奏拆。

**为什么这个 PR 是红的。** 行数棘轮红,是**故意的**,而且只有这一处红:账本上限现在是 359 行,本 PR 把它写到 **385 行**,多出 **26 行**。棘轮的规矩是「新增要靠删内容来买」,但这次没有可删的内容——账本里每一行都是一条还在用的读数,而且这次一行都没有重新折行(那在 2026-08-17 的裁决里明确不算货币)。所以这个 PR 不去动上限,而是把测量出来的数字摆到您面前:**请裁 385**(若 PR #15955 先落地,同样的 +26 对应 **388**)。
